post.description:
Returns selected Document Uploads for a Project.

Pass `view=ids_only` to receive an array of Document Upload ids instead of full objects.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Optional response view. Omit or pass `default` for full Document Upload objects. `ids_only` returns an array of ids and raises the `per_page` ceiling from 100 to 5000. The published `per_page` maximum reflects the default view.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Language for the response to be translated into

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
Comma-separated set of attributes to sort the list of records by.
    
Format: :primary_sort_attribute,:secondary_sort_attribute
    
Valid sort attribute options are [<field_id>, id]

ids.description: Array of Document Upload IDs to fetch.

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

x-code-samples.title: Node.js
Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"ids\":[\"string\"]}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v2.2/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/document_management/document_uploads/selected_uploads?view=SOME_STRING_VALUE&page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&locale=SOME_STRING_VALUE&sort=SOME_STRING_VALUE", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

x-changelog.summary: Point selected upload download_url at the v2 download route
x-changelog.description:
`download_url` on non-recycled selected Document Uploads now points at
`/rest/v2.0/companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/document_management/document_uploads/{id}/download`.
Previously issued `/rest/v1.0/.../collaborative_documents/document_uploads/{id}/download`
URLs still work.

`POST /document_management/document_uploads/selected_uploads` v2.2 returns
HTTP 200. The payload matches v2.1 (no `file_key`).

parameters.description: Unique company identifier associated with the Procore User Account.
